title: 跋桮 Pua̍h-pue
mood: stubborn fury that ends in a grin
subject: nineteen laughing divination blocks on quitting a job, then one holy block once the question becomes a three-thousand raise
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien metalcore with a nu-metal groove and temple imagery. Drop-tuned electric guitars playing syncopated chug riffs with pinch harmonics and half-time breakdowns; electric bass doubling the riff; drums in a heavy half-time groove with double-kick bursts and china-cymbal accents; a sampler layer of temple bells, one deep gong and firecracker crackle placed in the gaps between riffs. Tight, loud and modern, guitars wide, kick and snare forward, the temple sounds dry and close. Male vocal rapping the Taigi verses in a rhythmic flow, switching to hardcore screams on the shouted lines and a melodic half-clean hook in the chorus. 100 BPM, C minor in drop tuning. Stubborn fury that ends in a grin. No suona lead, no blast beats, no tremolo black-metal picking, no erhu, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
初一透早 三枝香 插甲直直直
我問神明 頭家遐爾歹 我敢會使辭頭路
兩塊桮 合佇手底 我共伊跋落去
兩塊 平面攏向天 笑桮

[Pre-Chorus]
笑桮!閣跋一擺!

[Chorus]
跋桮 跋桮 我跋規早起
神明 你咧笑 我嘛知
十九擺笑桮 廟公嘛咧笑
我 就毋信邪

[Verse]
我換一个問法 問較小可的
「若毋辭頭路 敢會使 加薪三千」
桮佇塗跤 輾兩輾 停落來
一爿向天 一爿覆咧

[Pre-Chorus]
聖桮!

[Chorus]
跋桮 跋桮 我跋規早起
神明 你咧笑 我嘛笑
十九擺笑桮 第二十擺 聖桮
明仔載 我去揣頭家

[Outro]
香 猶未燒了
我先來走
